title: Readings item
description: One item of the DynamoDB `readings` table: one sensor's readings for one second. Partition key `sensorId`, sort key `second`. Written by the processor as a conditional put, so a duplicate delivery changes nothing. `offsets[i]` is the millisecond offset (0-999) from `second` of `values[i]`; the arrays are parallel and in message order. Stored as arrays rather than one item per reading to stay near 1 WCU per item.

unit.description: From sensors.yaml for the sensor type.

ttl.description: 24 hours after the item is written.
